page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred dedication list; no margin notes; ornamental rule at head above the text; closing signature line at foot.

main_text.head: Reverendis, Clarißimis, Pietate Omnigena ac multijuga Eruditione Conspicuis Viris,
main_text.p: Dn. ABRAHAMO de LOSEA, Ecclesiæ Bernensis Pastor indefesso, Agnato suo ac Patrono ad aras usq; colendo.
Dn. DAVIDI ALBINO, Philosophiæ Professori solidissimæ Acutissimo, Collegij in Pædagogio Inspectori fidelissimo, studiorum suorum Promotori indefinenter observando.
Dn. SAMUELI HENZIO, Linguæ Græcæ ac Philosophiæ Practicæ Professori sagacissimo, Agnato suo itidem debitæ observantiæ cultu jugiter prosequendo.
main_text.head: Nec Non
Gravitate, Prudentiâ ac multarum rerum peritiâ Spectatissimis Viris,
main_text.p: Dn. GUILIELMO BERSETH, apud Rhætos inalpinos Chiliarchiâ olim, ac duplici nuper Præfectura in Erlach ac Oberhofen strenuè defuncto, Mecœnati suo summô Obsequiô colendo.
Dn. JOH. RODOLPHO ZEENDERO, Oeconomiâ Zophingensi laudatissimè defuncto, Patrono suo æviternùm Venerando.
Dn. GEORGIO STEINEGGERO, Consuli Zophingensi prudentissimo, Fautori suo Benevolentissimo, debitè observando.
main_text.head: Quin Etiam
main_text.p: Dn. CHRISTIANO CHAMBRINO, Pastori Zophingensium pervigili, Fautori suo ac Promotori omni observantiæ genere devenerando.
Dn. PETRO HUBERO, Illustris Bernatum Metropolis Civi Meritissimo, Hospiti suo perpetim amando, colendo.
Dn. ADAMO SALCHLINO, Hypodidascalo Scholæ Castrovillanæ cordato, fratri suo Germano in seculorum myriades suspiciendo ac fraterno amore prosequendo.

p.i: Hasce studiorum suorum primitias in debitæ Observ. testeram quâ par est Humanitate, decerpit, dicat ac consecrat,

page.notes: Small show-through of the reverse page is visible in the middle and at right; ignored. Some letters in the dedication lines are faint at the right edge (e.g. "Obsequiô", "Venerando") and were read with care; ornamental rule at head is not text. The ligature-like "Dn." abbreviations are rendered in italics as a best reading of their small-capital form.
